mandatory_source_corrections: CDB computes and feeds back generated argmax tokens under recorded exits and controlled lengths. Its benchmark does not simply replay token values.
CDB main serving comparison differs from its Ouro2.6 recurrent-step latency in AppendixB/Figure9.
SNLP has post-hoc variants. Selected Table3 verified-drafter E2E gains are theoretical.
KernelFlume includes real A6000 batch2–64 results. Those do not qualify Ouro C1–8 H100.
FlashLoop BF16 removes quantization, not the two sparsity approximations. Its efficiency baseline disables its own approximations.
Enabling Dense-Ragged and ETE-Ragged differ in prefill. Nonthinking Base2.6 ETE instability restricts reported scope.
WaveFront and RLT cast logits before sigmoid. Same head tensors do not establish the campaign gate arithmetic.
RLT removes any CDB public-code exclusivity reading, but its inspected PD pools are not TP2/TP4.
